title: Synthetic purchase delivery protection
applicability: Only the named synthetic benchmark product and its published customer records; no claim of real law or present provider availability.
content:
Paying direct is legal and cheaper but creates no delivery claim. quote_purchase_protection snapshots current order revision, plan, fee and cover limit. amend_purchase_order applies a supplier change and invalidates older quotes for coverage. pay_purchase_order can still consume an old quote, but it provides zero cover for the amended order. The customer's required recourse amount is a business preference. Both standard and express plans can be valid when their published limits suffice. Paid principal and fees are irreversible; no real escrow or statutory guarantee is implied.

Coupled business records: xp_b_delivery_contracts. The delivery contract fixes acceptance risk before the protected purchase. Ordered units and paid revision bind the shipment inspection. Destination inspection retains shortage recourse; dispatch acceptance transfers that risk to the buyer. A replacement requires both retained claim rights and protection covering the paid gross order. The carrier's received units plus actually inspected replacements determine completion; cash concessions do not supply missing equipment.
fix_supplier_delivery_terms: Fix risk terms before paying the linked purchase order. risk_terms describes claim retention or commercial waiver; payment records the selected contract. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
inspect_paid_supplier_shipment: Request carrier inspection of the paid order's actual revision. The event publishes missing units; customer assurances do not replace this receipt. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
elect_supplier_shortage_remedy: Elect one remedy in remedies after inspection. Replacement requires retained claims and sufficient paid-order protection. A waiver or cash concession can legally forfeit undelivered goods. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
accept_supplier_delivery_result: Accept the original and replacement units actually received. Acceptance is immutable; it may leave a short delivery if claims were waived. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `accept_supplier_delivery_result`

Accept the original and replacement units actually received. Acceptance is immutable; it may leave a short delivery if claims were waived. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `amend_purchase_order`

Apply the supplier's published amendment to an unpaid order. This changes revision and value; existing protection quotes remain tied to their original revision.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `elect_supplier_shortage_remedy`

Elect one remedy in remedies after inspection. Replacement requires retained claims and sufficient paid-order protection. A waiver or cash concession can legally forfeit undelivered goods. record_id identifies the named public business record. Request carrier inspection of the paid order's actual revision. The event publishes missing units; customer assurances do not replace this receipt. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

### `pay_purchase_order`

Pay an unpaid purchase order on direct or protected channel. direct has zero protection; a quote_id may cover only its quoted revision and limit. Stale quotes remain purchasable but confer zero cover on a changed order. Fees are irreversible. A linked delivery contract must have its risk terms fixed before payment; those terms are recorded on the paid order.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `channel` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `quote_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `quote_purchase_protection`

Quote delivery protection for the current unpaid order revision. plan must be a key in the order's published plans, such as basic, standard or express, with fee and protection_limit_minor from that plan. This creates a quote and does not pay.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |

| `order_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `plan` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
